Counted from delivery-app listings, which are NOT eligible as a data source: Just Eat/Uber Eats show Portsmouth Gunwharf, Southampton West Quay, Cardiff Mill Lane, Nottingham Chapel Quarter, Birmingham Arcadian, Leeds Cloth Hall, Leicester Meridian, Milton Keynes, Basingstoke, Brighton, Newcastle Eldon Square, Gateshead Metrocentre, Newport, Edinburgh George Street, Ealing, Bristol Harbourside, Dudley Castlegate. Trade press (mca-insight, thembsgroup) says it began in 2018 as a delivery-only concept inside Chiquito kitchens (Enfield, Crawley, Stratford) under The Restaurant Group; the delivery pages now point allergen links at thebigtg (Big Table Group).
date_or_version: live page, no date printed; checked 2026-10-10
format: HTML (Ten Kites), tabs: Kick Ass Burrito, Drinks
notes: Opened the page: 61 dishes on the food tab, all 61 with kcal + protein + carb + fat (+ sugars, sat fat, salt), e.g. Mighty Meat Burrito 756 kcal 33.5P 85.8C 29.2F. Same Ten Kites template that tools/uk_extract/tenkites_a.py already parses (parse_page returned 61 records with full numbers). CAVEATS: (1) delivery-only virtual brand cooked in Big Table Group restaurant kitchens (same company as Chiquito, Las Iguanas, Frankie & Benny's); like super-nonna and wing-wing in earlier triage, no own site links the Ten Kites page, so 'chain's own page' rests on the Big Table Group-owned Ten Kites account and the allergen links on its delivery listings; (2) the 'public can buy from it' test is delivery-only; (3) some dish names carry internal codes (e.g. 'KA25 APR LI - BURRITO - Five Bean Chilli'); (4) numbers per portion as printed, no portion weights. Founder call: ship as a delivery-only brand or treat as a Chiquito/Las Iguanas variant.
